metadata.title: Famous Champaran/Handi/Ahuna Meat in Delhi/NCR at Rustic Kitchen (Previously Known As Fiery Handi)
metadata.description:
Fiery Handi has been renamed as Rustic Kitchen and the location has shifted to Khanna Market, Delhi. 

Complete Address:
Shop No. 104,
Khanna Market, Lodhi Road, 
New Delhi. 

Contact No:
9311020729
97176 30432

Champaran meat also known as handi or ahuna meat is a classic rustic style meat curry from Champaran in Bihar. This popular lamb curry from the state is now winning hearts of the people in and around Delhi where a lot of Champaran meat outlets have come up. One such place whose handi mutton is gaining huge popularity in Greater Noida is Fiery Handi. What makes this place a must try for all handi meat lovers is that they use the best quality ingredients. Watch till the end to enjoy all the drooling details of their handi meat recipe.

To establish your Champaran Mutton kitchen Setup contact 
Agastya Food Services +919102913413

About the host - Anubhav Sapra
https://anubhavsapra.com/
 
Anubhav Sapra is an avid culinary explorer who loves to travel and explore different cuisines primarily the street food, not just for the sake of gustatory pleasure but also for quenching his deep thirst for nurturing new cultural connections through the kaleidoscopic canvas of food. He believes that the vibrant and delectable street food tradition across the globe has the power to bring communities together and foster harmonious human existence.
